name: pulsify-thumbnail-retouch
purpose: Soft retouch of a real photo or a real screen recording into a usable thumbnail. Never generation. The source image is the subject; the edit only removes what competes with it.

identity_lock.description: Non-negotiable across every pattern. The person is a source asset, not creative clay.
preserve_exactly: face structure, proportions and all facial features
skin texture, including blemishes, marks and pores
forbidden: reshaping, slimming or widening the face or body
straightening posture or altering the pose
replacing the person with a generated likeness
adding or removing facial hair, makeup or accessories
zooming, reframing or re-cropping the subject
changing the camera angle or perspective

background.rule: Keep the real room. Tidy it, never replace it.
allowed: tidy bedding, smooth fabric, straighten pillows
reduce or remove small clutter that competes with the subject
even out distracting bright spots or harsh shadows
remove screen overlays, notification popups and watermarks
forbidden: replacing the room with a studio, office or gradient
adding luxury objects, cars, watches or cash that were not in the original frame
removing real gear such as microphones, arms, monitors or chairs

grade.contrast: lift slightly so the subject separates from the background
grade.lighting: must stay natural; no relighting, no rim lights, no glow
grade.target: looks like a good photo, not an edited one

A_raw_photo.when: one person, real room, the image alone carries the tension
A_raw_photo.notes: The most human end of the range. Default for a talking-head video where the title carries the whole promise.

B_board_breakdown.when: explaining a system or framework off a real board
B_board_breakdown.layout: board fills the frame as the background; person at the board or as a small inset
B_board_breakdown.text: short headline permitted, black uppercase on a yellow bar; one to three small labels with hand-drawn arrows into specific parts of the board
B_board_breakdown.notes: The only pattern where the yellow bar survives. The headline is structural because a board cannot be read at 120px.

C_screen_recording.when: the proof is on a screen: chart, dashboard, ledger, platform UI
C_screen_recording.layout: the real interface at real scale filling the frame; face in a small corner inset shaped like a webcam overlay
must_crop_out: browser chrome, tabs and URL bar
application sidebars not needed to read the number
OS taskbar, clock, tray and desktop icons
C_screen_recording.text: none preferred; a plain short lowercase label is acceptable; no yellow bar, no all-caps headline
C_screen_recording.emphasis: a single hand-drawn circle or arrow around the key number is permitted
C_screen_recording.notes: Highest-leverage pattern when the creator already records their screen.

D_two_people.when: interview, mentor and student, or the second person is part of the proof
D_two_people.layout: two people mid-action in a real location
D_two_people.text: restrained; a speech-bubble question or two plain words; numbers usually absent
D_two_people.notes: The real location is what makes these work. Never an AI background.

banned_everywhere: any figure not already visible on the real screen behind it
MrBeast styling, glow, bevel, gloss or 3D effects
text_treatment.case: lowercase or sentence case everywhere except the Pattern B yellow bar
text_treatment.harmony_rule: thumbnail text never repeats a word from the title; the thumbnail carries the punchline, the title carries the context

output.readability_check: must read at 120px wide: subject, key number and any text all legible
